The script lists Vampire Lord Form (a Dawnguard spell), probably so it can be taken away. It isn't a reward. Both endings say the ritual fails.
Linking this to A Forlorn Hope comes from that mod's name and Falion's letter. The extracts don't show what sends the letter, or whether killing Falion blocks it.
Rising at Dawn adds a cure potion to this quest and has Falion talk about a potion that once cured vampirism, but the extracts don't show whether you can end up cured here.
